evidence_shape_matches_kind.name: evidence_shape_matches_kind
evidence_shape_matches_kind.value:
"evidence"."removed_at" is not null
          or ("evidence"."kind" = 'file' and "evidence"."original_path" is not null and "evidence"."link_url" is null)
          or ("evidence"."kind" = 'link' and "evidence"."link_url" is not null and "evidence"."original_path" is null)

evidence_published_is_reviewed.name: evidence_published_is_reviewed
evidence_published_is_reviewed.value:
"evidence"."status" <> 'published' or "evidence"."removed_at" is not null
          or ("evidence"."reviewed_by" is not null and "evidence"."reviewed_at" is not null
              and ("evidence"."kind" = 'link' or "evidence"."verified_statement" is not null))

market_proposals_about_something.name: market_proposals_about_something
market_proposals_about_something.value:
("market_proposals"."venue_name" is not null and "market_proposals"."campus" is not null
      and "market_proposals"."category" is not null and "market_proposals"."window_start_at" is not null) or "market_proposals"."startup_id" is not null

markets_priced_once_approved.name: markets_priced_once_approved
markets_priced_once_approved.value:
"markets"."approved_at" is null or ("markets"."opening_probability_bp" is not null
        and "markets"."initial_yes_shares_micro" is not null and "markets"."initial_no_shares_micro" is not null
        and "markets"."yes_shares_micro" is not null and "markets"."no_shares_micro" is not null)

markets_has_subject.name: markets_has_subject
markets_has_subject.value:
"markets"."subject_user_id" is not null or ("markets"."venue_id" is not null and "markets"."campus" is not null
        and "markets"."category" is not null and "markets"."resolution_source_id" is not null
        and "markets"."window_start_at" is not null and "markets"."window_end_at" is not null and "markets"."window_end_at" > "markets"."window_start_at"
        and "markets"."time_zone" is not null and "markets"."yes_condition" is not null and "markets"."no_condition" is not null
        and "markets"."evidence_deadline_at" >= "markets"."window_end_at")
        or ("markets"."startup_id" is not null and "markets"."milestone_kind" is not null and "markets"."resolution_source_id" is not null
        and "markets"."time_zone" is not null and "markets"."yes_condition" is not null and "markets"."no_condition" is not null)

startup_updates_has_owner.name: startup_updates_has_owner
startup_updates_has_owner.value: "startup_updates"."startup_id" is not null or "startup_updates"."founder_id" is not null
